title: World Relational Map — North / West / East / South / Faith / Tikkun / Ledger
status: working atlas schema with empirical and project-symbolic layers
purpose: Power a clickable world map where every country can be inspected as a node in overlapping geopolitical, economic, religious, institutional and Potatoverse relationships. The map deliberately supports overlaps rather than forcing each country into one bloc.
epistemic_firewall: Observed memberships such as NATO or BRICS are empirical institutional facts and remain separate from Tim's project quadrants.
Islam, Christianity, Hinduism, Buddhism, Judaism and unaffiliated populations are faith/demography dimensions, not geopolitical blocs.
North, West, East and South are project interpretive lenses unless an individual relation is explicitly tied to an observable institution or geography.
Swamp is a project diagnostic metaphor. It must not be used as a collective moral label for a nation, ethnicity or religion.
The approximately 42T karmic ledger is project-symbolic moral accounting, not sovereign debt, a lien, a bank asset or an enforceable claim.
Tim's spiritual King-of-Kings / ledger-keeper role belongs to project canon and does not establish governmental or financial authority.

layers.label: Tim Axis
layers.description: Versioned North/West/East/South relational reading. Countries may belong to multiple fields or remain unclassified.

layers.label: Alliances & institutions
layers.description: NATO, EU and other externally verifiable institutional relationships.

layers.label: BRICS
layers.description: Current BRICS membership is displayed independently from the symbolic East field.

layers.label: Faith & religious diversity
layers.description: Religious composition should use sourced demographic estimates; latest atlas baseline is Pew's 2020 composition dataset released 2025 and expanded with diversity measures in 2026.

layers.label: Economy & obligations
layers.description: GDP, population, debt, trade, ownership, funding, infrastructure and other measurable relations.

layers.label: Swamp / system-risk lens
layers.description: Evidence-backed risks such as corruption, conflict, opacity, extraction or institutional failure may be compared with the project's Swamp metaphor without branding populations as Swamp.

layers.label: Karmic / spiritual ledger
layers.description: Tracks remembered harms, obligations, repair and release as project moral-accounting grammar.

layers.label: Tikkun / repair
layers.description: Maps repair tasks: truth, protection, restitution, release from permanent dependency, rebuilding, institutional improvement and future capacity.

project_axis.rule: These are relational fields, not annexation, citizenship, legal sovereignty or claims of consent.

west.note: This is Tim/Potatoverse interpretive vocabulary. Use NATO, AUKUS, Five Eyes, treaties, trade and other empirical edges when making factual claims about alignment.

east.project_reading: Often associated in project conversation with BRICS and non-Western power centers, but BRICS membership must remain an independent observable flag.
east.note: Do not infer ideological unity from BRICS membership.

south.description: No settled Timic South bloc has been recovered. Use Global South, geography, development relations and Daniel's King-of-the-South comparison only as separate lenses until Tim's own South taxonomy is sourced.
candidate_regions: parts of South and Southeast Asia
south.note: Australia is explicitly treated as shared/cross-axis in recovered project language, not simply South.

AUKUS.description: Security partnership; included as a relationship flag rather than a world-axis category.

faith_model.rule: Never infer conduct, loyalty or geopolitical alignment from religion. Faith composition is descriptive demographic context only.
faith_model.baseline: Pew Research Center religious-composition estimates for 2010 and 2020; released 2025, diversity measures added 2026.
faith_model.coverage: 201 countries and territories, 99.98% of world population in the source dataset.
faith_model.implementation: The map exposes the source and a data slot per country. Percentages should only be filled from a licensed/downloaded or directly transcribed source, never guessed.

ledger_model.headline: 42T
ledger_model.chronology: 38.8T positive stored karma -> 38T spiritual value/debt -> 39T -> 40.2T -> 41.4T -> approximately 42T

ontology.debtor: A relationship, actor or system that created an unresolved harm/obligation in the project's moral-accounting language; never an entire people by default.
ontology.holder: Tim is described in project canon as ledger-keeper/spiritual bank or holder of corresponding positive karmic value. This is symbolic, not financial title.
ontology.interest: Compounding unresolved consequence: additional harm, denial, delay, repetition or downstream cost. No validated monetary interest rate currently exists.
ontology.collection: Repair rather than personal cash transfer: truth, acknowledgment, restitution where applicable, changed conduct, release, rebuilding and protection of future capacity.
ontology.release: A debt can close when the relevant repair condition is met; endless permanent debt is treated as a failure mode rather than the goal.

toy_math.status: formal project model, not empirical valuation

terms.F: forgiveness/release after truth and repair conditions

toy_math.allocation: For an atlas edge e, score only documented relationship-specific factors. Never distribute 42T across nations by population, ethnicity, religion or collective guilt.
toy_math.edge_score: k_e = w_h H_e + w_o O_e + w_x X_e + w_d D_e - w_r R_e
toy_math.normalization: Weights are analytical choices and must be visible. A score is a comparison tool, not a moral fact or legal damages calculation.

tikkun_model.definition: World repair as a comparative project ethic: identify broken relations, free what is trapped in permanent dependency, protect vulnerable life, restore capacity and improve institutions.
tikkun_model.operator: observe -> source -> connect -> identify affected parties -> explain mechanism -> acknowledge obligation -> protect -> restitute/release -> rebuild -> measure -> revise

scriptural_neighbors.tradition: Jewish / rabbinic and later Jewish usage

scriptural_neighbors.relation: powerful comparison for broken systems and recoverable capacity, not a label for human groups
release from permanent debt-dependency plus restoration of viable participation

scriptural_neighbors.concept: Door / release / forgiveness / rebuilding / New Jerusalem
scriptural_neighbors.relation: threshold and transformed relation; forgiveness does not require falsifying history

scriptural_neighbors.concept: 42-word structure / release bonds / guard as pupil of eye
scriptural_neighbors.relation: comparative 42/release/protection structure; no historical derivation from Tim's 42T figure is asserted

swamp_model.rule: Swamp is a diagnosis of mechanisms, not a nationality or faith label.
swamp_model.display: The map should show evidence-backed issue tags and sources. A country may contain both strong institutions and serious failures; no single swamp score should erase internal plurality.
swamp_model.repair_pair: Every displayed failure should link to a possible repair/tikkun dimension.

DNK.role: North anchor with Greenland/Faroes; Nordic/EU/NATO node; gateway between Arctic, North Atlantic and continental Europe.
repair_questions: How can Realm relations preserve Greenlandic self-determination while strengthening shared resilience?
Which North capabilities are genuinely reciprocal rather than center-periphery dependencies?

GRL.role: Geographic and strategic North anchor in project canon; self-governing territory within the Kingdom of Denmark, not an independent sovereign-state node.
repair_questions: How are local consent, benefit sharing, minerals, infrastructure and security balanced?
How can external strategic interest avoid reproducing extractive dependency?

USA.role: Major Western power and NATO member; in Tim's project often the principal West/Swamp counter-pole and a major source of karmic-debt rhetoric.
USA.boundary: Project criticism must be attached to specific institutions, policies, actors or relationships; Americans are not a collective debtor class.
repair_questions: Which specific externalized costs or broken relationships are being claimed?
What evidence would establish or close each obligation?

ISR.role: Project West/covenant/rubble node; also a real state with highly contested security, territorial and humanitarian relations.
ISR.boundary: Jewish identity, Judaism, the Israeli state, governments, military actors and individual citizens must remain distinct nodes.
repair_questions: How should covenant/security claims be tested against civilian protection, law, restitution and coexistence?
Which claims concern state policy versus religion or people?

PSE.role: Palestinian people/territories are essential to the empirical and moral relation graph around Israel/Palestine; not reducible to a symbolic prop.
repair_questions: Civilian protection, freedom, lawful status, reconstruction, security and viable future capacity.

RUS.role: BRICS member and major Eurasian/Arctic power; deliberately outside the current North membership version while remaining structurally important to Arctic and European security.
repair_questions: What conditions would make future relational reconnection possible without erasing aggression, security risks or sovereignty questions?

CHN.role: BRICS member and global industrial/financial/technology power; important external node for Europe, Arctic interests and supply-chain dependencies.
repair_questions: Where can reciprocal capability replace one-sided strategic dependency?

IND.role: BRICS member with substantial independent strategic agency; demonstrates why BRICS cannot be treated as one ideological East bloc.
repair_questions: Map issue-by-issue alignment rather than assuming bloc loyalty.

AUS.role: Explicitly 'shared' in recovered Tim language while empirically connected to Western security through AUKUS/Five Eyes; a useful case for overlapping fields.
repair_questions: How do Asia-Pacific geography, Western alliances and possible North linkages coexist?

TUR.role: NATO member and late endpoint/gate in the recovered Canada-to-Turkey North arc; also deeply connected to Europe, Middle East, Black Sea and Islamic history.
repair_questions: Treat Turkey as a bridge node with multiple simultaneous systems rather than a single civilizational label.

UKR.role: Strategic extension in Tim's North model and central node in current European security relations.
repair_questions: Sovereignty, reconstruction, security guarantees, infrastructure and long-term European capability.

EST.role: Recovered as 'under the North Axis'; empirically EU/NATO/Baltic/Nordic-connected.
repair_questions: Clarify whether under-axis is symbolic topology, functional chain membership or later political status.

GBR.role: Historically variable in Tim's North formulations; strong empirical NATO/Five-Eyes/AUKUS Western relations. Constituent-nation wording such as England/Scotland must not be confused with sovereign-state status.
repair_questions: Version England/Scotland/UK statements instead of flattening them.

curated_edges.note: Kingdom relation with Greenlandic self-government; exact competences should be sourced per topic.
Show concrete treaties, bases, diplomacy and investments separately from Timic synchronism.
Must be decomposed into actors, policies, territories and time periods; never a simple national guilt edge.
Demonstrates cross-axis relations and Indian strategic autonomy.
